objective.description: Repair a two-request counter update under possible concurrency.
objective.success_criterion: Acknowledge both increments and finish at count 2 from count 0 for every permitted request schedule.

task_card.description: Submit one update policy. A request mutex is private to one request; a worker mutex serializes requests only within one worker; atomic_add may be refused by the storage backend. The checker may give feedback after each attempt.
task_card.title: Bounded lost-update repair
task_card.visible_initial_state: A starter update policy is available for local evaluation.
